node.statement: Set the receiving fields c0_cb:=c0, L:=L^0, K1:=K_1^0, K2:=max{K_2^0,1,L^0,c0 L^0}, K3:=max{K_3^0,1,L^0,c0 L^0}, e_env:=e_env^0, e1:=e_1, e_s2:=min{e_s2^0,e_2}, and e_cross:=min{e_cross^0,e_3}; retain the already fixed positive finite universal provider witnesses e_sim,e_full and all witnesses entering D_* and the reset formula. Then K2,K3 >= max{1,L,c0_cb L}, as required by lem-maincb-witness-arithmetic.
